name: tembi-intelligence-dev
description: This MCP server provides tools for getting insights about last mile delivery providers market analysis across Europe.

_published_faq.name: How do I add tembi-intelligence-dev to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add tembi-intelligence-dev to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://ca-mcp-gateway-dev.agreeablegrass-4e3a9723.swedencentral.azurecontainerapps.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the tembi-intelligence-dev MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: tembi-intelligence-dev provides these MCP tools: calculate_delivery_market_share, calculate_delivery_market_share_trend, calculate_webshop_population_share, checkout_pricing_benchmark, get_queryable_values, get_report_content, identify_competitors, list_reports, push_report, and user_context.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to tembi-intelligence-dev?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to tembi-intelligence-dev in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
tembi-intelligence-dev requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
tembi-intelligence-dev is developed by Tembi. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
